entities.name: Calmont
entities.description: Influential, rigidly law-abiding bureaucrat of Aysen on Ulgrotha who could detain citizens and opposed the Death Speakers.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Country of Ulgrotha governed by a famously formalistic bureaucracy.

entities.name: Death Speakers
entities.description: Group Calmont viewed as a significant threat.

entities.name: Serra Inquisitors
entities.description: Priests whose campaign against perceived menaces influenced Calmont.

entities.name: Murat
entities.description: Death Speaker who viewed Calmont's kind unfavorably.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Dark-agenda figure who compared bureaucrats like Calmont to vipers.

relations.note: viewed them as a significant threat
relations.quote: His power was particularly evident in his stance against the Death Speakers
Critics like Murat , a Death Speaker, and Baron Sengir , with his dark agenda, viewed him and his kind unfavorably
